Select Features via the CPOP Algorithm

Source: R/cpop_select.R
select_cpop_features.Rd

Runs CPOP step 1 (iterated elastic-net selection with cohort intersection) followed by CPOP step 2 (sign-agreement pruning using ridge refits) on the pairwise log-ratio representation of the input. Features are returned as "A--B" pair names produced by pairwise_col_diff(); for log-normalised expression data these are mathematically equivalent to log-ratios.

select_cpop_features(
  x_list,
  y_list,
  n_features = 50L,
  n_iter = 20L,
  alpha = 1,
  lambda_choice = c("lambda.min", "lambda.1se"),
  penalty = NULL,
  sign_consistency_threshold = 1,
  prune_collinear = TRUE,
  family = "binomial",
  assay = NULL,
  cv_control = list()
)

Arguments

x_list

A matrix-like object, SummarizedExperiment, or list of such objects. Rows are samples, columns are features. Original CPOP is defined for two cohorts; this implementation generalises by intersecting selections across all cohorts at every CPOP step.

y_list

A binary response factor aligned with x_list (levels c("No", "Yes")). Provide a list when x_list is a list.

n_features

Maximum number of pair features to retain (default 50).

n_iter

Maximum number of iterations for both steps (default 20).

alpha

Elastic-net mixing parameter for step 1. Default 1 (lasso). A numeric vector triggers CPOP's alpha sweep: features carried over from earlier alphas are exempted from the penalty in later passes.

lambda_choice

Either "lambda.min" (default) or "lambda.1se".

penalty

Optional numeric vector of glmnet penalty.factor values named by pair feature. When NULL, colmeans_penalty() is used, matching the CPOP default.

sign_consistency_threshold

Minimum fraction of cohorts required to agree on coefficient sign in step 2. Default 1.0 is the canonical CPOP rule (unanimous agreement).

prune_collinear

Logical; if TRUE (default), removes redundant ratios by retaining a minimum spanning tree of the implied feature graph (matching CPOP's mst_lratio).

family

glmnet family. Default "binomial".

assay

For SummarizedExperiment inputs, the assay name or index.

cv_control

Optional named list of arguments forwarded to glmnet::cv.glmnet().

Value

A list with the selected pair features, the union of base genes they reference, the step-1 intermediate set, per-iteration logs, and the ridge coefficient matrix from the final step-2 pass.

See also

fit_cpop_panel(), select_transferable_features()
